channel.title: OmniSource Updates
channel.description: OmniSource is a curated, automatically maintained AltStore-compatible iOS app source. Every entry is resolved from the app's own official upstream project - GitHub Releases or the developer's official AltStore feed - and each download link is re-verified automatically.

item.title: Mornye v5.2.6
item.description:
Mornye 5.2.6 | Mornye-v5.2.6-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **library**: Sort songs and albums by file size - **desktop**: Add fullscreen and borderless window modes - **library**: List the files a scan could not read - **downloads**: Add custom folder path templates - **network**: Add Subsonic and OpenSubsonic support - **windows**: Prepare native ARM64 builds and packages - **player**: Color the current track row from its artwork - **desktop**: Open the mini player on Windows and Linux
### Bug Fixes
- **desktop**: List full screen and borderless shortcuts - **automix**: Verify beat alignment and hold phase through the mix - **home**: Keep explore artwork square - **flutter**: Backport semantics geometry crash fix - **tags**: Support ID3-prefixed FLAC metadata writes - **library**: Keep playlists accessible without local songs - **conversion**: Preserve quoted paths in lossy exports - **library**: Index songs whose tags fail to parse - **playback**: Allow MP3 playback with malformed ID3 tags - **automix**: Start the next song on the outgoing beat - **desktop**: Keep artist album selection and scroll position - **android**: Refresh media controls when track metadata changes - **windows**: Use the MSVC coroutine deprecation macro's real name - **windows**: Install the libmpv license and build on MSVC 14.5x - **library**: Keep liked local tracks visible during cover fades - **windows**: Support UNC library paths and network downloads - **desktop**: Restore private file access after cache removal - **notifications**: Handle Linux launch callbacks and contain queue alerts - **repo**: Move the store button under the text on narrow rows - **library**: Simplify duplicate review rows and expose load errors - **settings**: Keep final controls clear of floating playback bars - **home**: Collapse the empty prompt after installing an extension - **library**: Emphasize Play in collection header actions - **library**: Read tagless audio without losing document names - **desktop**: Wrap search and store category filters - **desktop**: Add scroll arrows to artist and recent shelves - **settings**: Restore 5.2.1 card contrast - **network**: Flush and verify SMB uploads before publishing - **android**: Resolve SAF audio paths when saving lyrics - **desktop**: Handle missing initial download folders
### Refactoring
- **onboarding**: Remove the rebrand introduction tour
### Testing
- **library**: Expect the sort sheet to scroll at its cap - **player**: Cover mini player metadata refresh and session restore
### Chores
- Update AltStore source to v5.2.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot]) - Bump version to 5.2.6 (165) - **license**: Adopt LGPL-3.0-only for Mornye
**Full Changelog**: [v5.2.5...v5.2.6](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/compare/v5.2.5...v5.2.6)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-arm32.apk` (older devices) - `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them
#### iOS - **iOS**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the SHA-256 of every file above.
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: Eclipse v2.3.0
item.description:
Eclipse 2.3.0 | Eclipse-unsigned-v2.3.0-20261020-090254
Additions:
-Deep tracker library integration option (AniList, MAL, Trakt) -Simkl Tracking (Will NOT get deep tracking integration due to free tier limits) -Ratings and Notes setting -Concurrent download controls -Background HLS downloading (iOS 26+ only) -Subtitle delay -Dolby Atmos and Dolby Vision support -epub support (experimental) -Light novel reader rework

-Fixed mpv backgrounding audio desync, it should take a sec to recover. -Fixed mpv downstream blowing up -Changed Alt poster and season building to be more accurate, tested 220 anime, and 100 western shows -Fixed unaired episode hiding -Fixed System calendar crash, app now enforces Gregorian calendar -Fixed Ratings and Notes getting lost -Removed Performance mode and watch together. item.title: Mornye v5.2.0
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 5.2.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.2.0-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **crash**: Show persistent crash reports on Home - **about**: Link the lyrics website and service status - **player**: Search lyrics online for files without them - **lyrics**: Add lrc.red and BetterLyrics, split SpotiFLAC-Mobile Lyrics - **home**: Greet in the header and gather listening shortcuts - **onboarding**: Introduce the 5.2 release tour - **library**: Add adaptive icons to collection tabs - **home**: Localize greetings and address profile names - **home**: Expose extension country settings and isolate regional caches - **lyrics**: Refresh quote sharing and load lyrics on demand - **android**: Refresh launcher widgets with adaptive expressive layouts - **player**: Add configurable full-screen cover art - **player**: Synchronize music haptics with local playback - **lyrics**: Share lyric cards and refine timed vocal transitions - **player**: Show audio source processing and output details - **equalizer**: Add multiband EQ and per-player native audio processing - **autoplay**: Enable personalization by default and confirm learning resets - **a11y**: Label controls and improve settings contrast and targets - **i18n**: Add player feature text and clarify built-in playback - **loading**: Align skeletons with collection and extension layouts - **player**: Share volume controls across Material and Mornye - **rewind**: Add yearly highlights and seasonal library banners - **forms**: Adopt expressive inputs with consistent form state - **ui**: Add themed menus and adaptive checkbox rows - **ui**: Unify content cards and preserve press behavior - **layout**: Adapt tablet navigation and center wide content - **listening**: Show a skeleton while statistics load - **listening**: Add Rewind highlights and refresh statistics - **player**: Refine mini-player and queue feedback - **library**: Add sectioned browsing and adaptive fast scrolling - **material**: Unify progress and surface transitions - **material**: Animate header action groups and collapse - **settings**: Connect custom Material settings rows - **settings**: Connect standard Material settings rows - **ui**: Add Material Expressive spring motion - **lyrics**: Add SpotiFLAC fallback for Apple Music outages - **ui**: Extend Material Expressive surfaces and playback controls - **theme**: Show a check on selected expressive switches - **theme**: Adopt Material Symbols and expressive components - **metadata**: Add per-field download tag separators
### Bug Fixes
- **crash**: Match the Home crash card to the error card style - **library**: Recover interrupted scans and stale notifications - **downloads**: Offer folder recovery for permission failures - **equalizer**: Keep headroom and limiter choices when applying a preset - **lyrics**: Restore QQ Music search after the desktop CGI broke - **player**: Restore the lighter full-screen cover scrim - **storage**: Retain legacy Android cipher migration support - **library**: Recover missing local album artwork from audio - **library**: Restore bit depth as the default quality badge - **haptics**: Analyze document audio across skips and AutoMix - **player**: Report Android output failures without skipping tracks - **network**: Request Android 17 local network access before NAS connections - **theme**: Retain dominant cover colors in player backgrounds - **automix**: Align effect handoffs and render sufficient source audio - **downloads**: Recover native queues when their service dies - **verification**: Bound browser handoffs and release expired dialogs - **player**: Size volume slider handle proportionally - **settings**: Use shared sheet for log level selection - **headers**: Fit artwork and unify toolbar controls - **metadata**: Align separator picker with Settings components - **settings**: Unify adaptive sheet layout and drag behavior - **player**: Expose favorites and shuffle in Material notifications - **audio**: Preserve FLAC precision in Android bit-perfect playback - **extensions**: Use adaptive icons for installed extension avatars - **library**: Align filter and sort sheet sizing and dismissal - **player**: Prevent overlapping titles during rapid skips - **storage**: Preserve audio MIME when publishing SAF downloads - **lyrics**: Refresh LRC sidecars in their actual SAF folder - **download**: Probe M4A streams before preserving requested FLAC - **automix**: Wait for advancing audio before starting fades
### Performance
- **lyrics**: Compile credit regexes once - **library**: Build DateFormat and RegExp once instead of per row - **history**: Suppress unchanged membership notifications - **history**: Reuse unchanged download lookup indexes - **releases**: Narrow weekly release provider dependencies - **lyrics**: Cache timed lyric segment geometry - **player**: Cache adjacent track titles during swipes
### Refactoring
- **android**: Share the SAF scan percent and CUE helpers - **android**: Move SAF batch exists and modtime queries out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF tree listing and executors out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF CUE helpers out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF scan checkpointing out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Move SAF file inspection out of MainActivitySafScan.kt - **android**: Put the SAF IO helpers on Context receivers - **android**: Share the foreground wake lock and start helper between the two services - **providers**: Share one Coalescer for single-flight request coalescing - **android**: Move the lifecycle backend calls into MainActivityLifecycleCalls.kt - **android**: Move the download service and worker backend calls into MainActivityServiceCalls.kt - **android**: Move the library scan backend calls into MainActivityLibraryScanCalls.kt - **android**: Move the metadata and tag backend calls into MainActivityMetadataCalls.kt - **android**: Move the SAF backend calls into MainActivitySafCalls.kt - **android**: Move install state, extension intents, SAF leases and small channels out of MainActivity.kt - **library**: Split local_library_provider.dart into source, scan and cover parts - **library**: Share the scan completion tail as _finishScan - **library**: Remove the unreachable snapshot sub-branch of the incremental scan - **convert**: Route single-track conversion through the shared pipeline - **queue**: Move the completion bridge into CompletionBridgeTracker - **queue**: Move library paging state into QueueLibraryPager - **bridge**: Share one generic cache entry and put/prune helper - **collections**: Move playlist cover file I/O into PlaylistCoverStore - **cache**: Move directory scanning and clearing into CacheMaintenanceService - **analysis**: Move the FFmpeg runner out of the widget - **analysis**: Move the analysis disk cache into audio_analysis_cache.dart - **analysis**: Move the pure FFmpeg builders and parsers to a service - **setup**: Move SharedPreferences access behind SetupProgressStore and SafMigrationPromptStore - **providers**: Move UI-declared providers to lib/providers - **rust**: Rename mod.rs modules to the foo.rs + foo/ layout - **concerts**: Move the calendar channel into a service - **repo**: Prepare install paths in the repo notifier - **share**: Share the widget capture helper - **extensions**: Share the extension health color and icon helpers - **playlists**: Share the playlist name prompt and dispose its controller - **artist**: Move the discography download into a part - **home**: Use downloadSingleTrack for search results - **storage**: Share the SAF download tree pick - **layout**: Share responsiveScale and effectiveTextScale - **layering**: Move logic files out of screens - **layering**: Move model files to models and fix inverted imports - **layering**: Move UI action helpers from services and utils to controllers - item.title: Reynard v0.18.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.18.0 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.17.1...0.18.0
### New Features - When a webpage uses a keyboard shortcut that conflicts with one of the app's, the first press now goes to the webpage, and a hint appears in the address bar letting you press the shortcut again to trigger the app's.
### Improvements - Scrolling on webpages is now smoother and more accurate. - Improved audio handling, with better echo cancellation, voice processing, recovery after interruptions, and handling of audio device changes.
### Bug Fixes - Fixed an issue where keyboard shortcuts would not be recognized by websites after using Find in Page or a `<select>` element. - Fixed an issue where the image preview and its actions would not work on certain images, such as those requiring authentication or in the WebP format. - Fixed an issue where tapping the status bar to scroll to the top would not scroll completely to the top of the webpage when using the top address bar. - Fixed an issue where touches on some webpages would land in the wrong place. - Added small performance improvements and fixed several UI issues.
### Engine
Updated Gecko to [158.0](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_158_0_RELEASE) (released Oct 13, 2026).
